: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by

  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite f
  have pair : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ ∀ k : Fin 4, u (i + k) = u (j + k) := by
    have e (k : Fin 4) := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun he k)

    · exact ⟨a, b, h, e⟩
    · exact ⟨b, a, h, fun k => (e k).symm⟩

            prev 3 (by decide) (by decide), prev 4 (by decide) (by decide)]
